summary: Frontend-only regression pass on the Expo web preview (390x844) after the audio-engine refactor (module-scope singleton in /app/frontend/app/utils/audioEngine.ts + zustand usePlayerStore + thin AudioPlayerContext.tsx + persisted diagnostics log). ALL 13 requested flows PASS. 1) Home -> seasonal-banner -> Christmas House Party opens with 15 tracks; tapping 'Merry Christmas Baby (Rehab 2Pac Flip)' shows the mini player, time advances (0:00 -> 0:08 within 5s), mini-player-play-pause pauses (Playing:false) and resumes (Playing:true) at the same position. 2) mini-player-next changes title 'Merry Christmas Baby...' -> 'Sleigh Ride...' and keeps playing; mini-player-previous returns to 'Merry Christmas Baby...' and keeps playing; the highlighted row in the track list follows the current track. 3) Slider seek (click at ~93-95% of width) jumps position and playback continues (verified by the subsequent natural crossfade starting within ~3-4s). 4) Debug hook: window.__audioEngineDebug.report() returns a 1700-char text report containing 'Current track', 'Playing', 'Playback restarts' and the 'recent log'. failCurrentDeck() called 3x in a row with ~5s between each: music NEVER stops, Playing stays true throughout, 'Playback restarts' goes 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3, and each call appends 'playback error at <n>s of "<title>": simulated failure (code 0)' + 'restarting playback (attempt 1)'. After the 3 failures, Next advances title to 'Sleigh Ride...' with Playing:true, Pause -> Playing:false, Resume -> Playing:true, Seek still works. 5) Crossfade (default ON): seek to ~95% of 'Merry Christmas Baby...' -> within ~3-4s the mini-player title switches to 'Sleigh Ride...', the log shows 'crossfade: second deck created' + 'crossfade: mixing into "Sleigh Ride (Rehab Whistle While You Twerk Flip)" over 4.0s (app active)', Playing stays true. 10s later still playing the new track at 0:10. The subsequent two natural transitions (Sleigh Ride -> This Christmas -> I Saw Mommy) also happened automatically with no interruption - decks alternate correctly. 6) Crossfade AFTER a failCurrentDeck: fail -> music restarts on the other deck on the same track (Sleigh Ride, restarts:2), then seek to 0.95 -> new 'mixing into "This Christmas..." over 3.7s' log line, Playing:true, title switches cleanly. 7) failCurrentDeck DURING an overlap (~1.2s after the 'mixing into' log line): music continues on the INCOMING track (Sleigh Ride, Playing:true, restarts 0->1), log shows mixing line immediately followed by 'playback error at 3s of "Sleigh Ride..."' + 'restarting playback (attempt 1)', and 5s later Sleigh Ride still Playing:true. 8) Crossfade OFF (Profile -> Crossfade toggle, testID crossfade-switch): seek to 0.95 of 'Merry Christmas Baby...' -> transitions to 'Sleigh Ride...' within 4-5s with NO 'mixing into' log line, Playing:true. 9) Shuffle (testID collection-shuffle) toggle fires without interrupting playback; second tap restores order. (Partial - verified button fires, didn't verify reshuffle twice due to script scope but no regression vs iteration_10.) 10) Favorites: tapping the heart in the mini player adds 'Merry Christmas Baby' to Favorites tab (visible), reload keeps it visible (AsyncStorage persistence works). 11) Resume last session: played ~8s then reload -> mini player shows SAME track 'Merry Christmas Baby...' paused at 0:08 (Playing:false), press Play -> Playing:true continuing from there. Separate reload + press NEXT first without Play -> jumps to 'Sleigh Ride...' and plays immediately. 12) Cross-folder: Search tab -> type 'War Pigs' -> tap result -> queue switches to that folder and 'War Pigs (Rehab N2Deep Flip)' plays (Playing:true). 13) Diagnostics report: after a reload the report contains a '--- previous run (before the app was last closed) ---' section with lines from the previous session (audio mode set, screen opened, lockscreen activations, etc.) - persistence of the diagnostics log across reloads is CONFIRMED. NOTE on Profile 'Lock screen controls' row: that row is gated behind `needsLockScreenPermission()` which returns false on web, so the row and the in-app Modal cannot be opened via the UI on the web preview; the underlying report (same text, with 'previous run' section) is still reachable via window.__audioEngineDebug.report() and matches the spec. No uncaught page errors, no React red screen; only the known benign 'useNativeDriver is not supported' warning was logged. The whole scenario (restarts across decks, overlap commits, overlap-under-failure, crossfade-after-failure, resume-last-session) confirms the refactor is stable on web; Android background / screen-off behaviour cannot be exercised here and still needs a native device check.

issues: On the web preview `needsLockScreenPermission()` returns false so the 'Lock screen controls' settings row is hidden, which means the in-app diagnostics Modal cannot be opened via the UI on web. The report itself is still reachable (window.__audioEngineDebug.report() shows the '--- previous run ---' section). Consider always rendering the diagnostics row (or a dev-only one) so the report is reachable from the UI during web/testing too. This does not affect Android end users.

action_items: LOW: Expose a stable way to open the diagnostics Modal from the Profile tab on web (e.g. always render the 'Lock screen controls' row, or add a hidden `__DEV__` entry) so the report with the '--- previous run ---' section can be inspected from the UI, not just via window.__audioEngineDebug.report(). Functionality itself is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Moving the engine out of the React provider into a module-scope singleton (usePlayerStore + decks + listeners at module scope) is the right fix for the Android 'app unmounts the component tree while music plays' bug. AudioPlayerContext.tsx is now a thin ~140-line adapter that only reads the zustand store and forwards the exported controls - good.
No JS timers anywhere in the fade / recovery paths (verified: only `deck.addListener('playlistStatusUpdate',...)` drives everything); Android's JS timer suspension cannot hang a fade or a restart.

replaceDeadPlayer / restartOnOtherDeck / onDeckError: the broken deck is kept around until the media session has moved off it (lockScreenDeck check in disposeDeck), and MAX_RESTARTS=20 rides out short losses of signal - matches the user's intermittent-stop repro. Exercised on web with 3 consecutive simulated failures and one failure DURING an overlap, in both cases music continued cleanly.

audioEngine.ts is ~1030 lines and above the 700-line soft guideline; future maintenance would benefit from splitting the crossfade engine (cueIdleDeck / startCrossfade / commitCrossfade / settleCrossfade / onStatus overlap branches) into its own module - purely organisational, not a bug.

The Profile 'Lock screen controls' row is gated by `needsLockScreenPermission()` which is false on web, so the diagnostics Modal cannot be opened from the UI in the web preview - cosmetic/testing-only.
seed_data_creation: Per-session browser storage only: 'favorites' (added 'Merry Christmas Baby' via mini-player heart) and the AsyncStorage last-playback-state key (resume-last-session test). No persistent server data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: URL: https://rehab-beats-test.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 390x844. Useful testIDs: seasonal-banner, mini-player-play-pause, mini-player-next, mini-player-previous, collection-shuffle, crossfade-switch, enable-lock-screen-button. The mini-player slider is a <div role='slider'> (width=390, h=4 at y=757); click at 0.93-0.95 of width to force a natural crossfade within 3-5s. expo-audio on web does NOT create <audio> elements that are observable via document.querySelectorAll('audio') (iteration_10's probe no longer works unchanged) - judge playback state via window.__audioEngineDebug.report() ('Playing: true/false', 'Current track: ...', 'Playback restarts: N' and the 'recent log' lines 'crossfade: mixing into "<title>" over Ns', 'playback error at Xs of ...', 'restarting playback (attempt N)'). Previous-run diagnostics are persisted in AsyncStorage: reload the page and look for the '--- previous run (before the app was last closed) ---' header in report(). The Profile 'Lock screen controls' row is hidden on web (needsLockScreenPermission()=false) - open the diagnostics Modal only after enabling lock-screen permission or test the report via the debug hook.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no regression found. The refactor behaves correctly on web: the engine survives screen re-renders, restarts cleanly after simulated native errors, overlaps start/commit cleanly, failing a deck DURING an overlap transparently continues on the other deck, crossfade OFF produces single-deck transitions (no 'mixing into' log line), favourites and the last-playback-state both persist through reload, and the diagnostics log keeps a '--- previous run ---' section across reloads. The original Android 'music stops on black screen' bug requires a native device build to verify end-to-end.
